频率派与贝叶斯
The Frequentist and Bayesian Schools

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1 (17a)
  1. Be able to explain the difference between the frequentist and Bayesian approaches to statistics.
  2. Know our working definition of a statistic and be able to distinguish a statistic from a non-statistic.

第一份讲义有两个目标: 能解释频率派与贝叶斯方法的差别; 掌握本课对统计量的工作定义, 并判断一个量能否由数据和已知值计算.

前一个目标解决「概率用在什么对象上」, 后一个目标为后面的检验统计量和零分布做准备.

进入具体检验后, 每个公式都应能回答两个问题: 它使用的是哪一份数据, 它以哪个假设为条件. 坚持这样读, 就能避免把似然、后验概率和重复实验中的错误率混为一谈.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1 (17a)

After much foreshadowing, the time has finally come to switch from Bayesian statistics to frequentist statistics. For much of the twentieth century, frequentist statistics has been the dominant school. If you’ve ever encountered confidence intervals, p-values, t-tests, or χ2-tests, you’ve seen frequentist statistics. With the rise of high-speed computing and big data, Bayesian methods are becoming more common. After we’ve studied frequentist methods we will compare the strengths and weaknesses of the two approaches.

课程现在从贝叶斯统计转向 **frequentist statistics 频率派统计学**. 置信区间、p 值、t 检验和卡方检验都是频率派框架中的常见工具.

两派使用同一套概率论, 分歧主要在固定但未知的参数和假设能否拥有概率分布. 学完频率派方法后, 课程再系统比较两者的优缺点.

2.1 分岔点
2.1 The fork in the road

Page 1 (17a)

Both schools of statistics start with probability. In particular both know and love Bayes’ theorem:

P(H∣D)=P(D)P(D∣H)P(H)​.

When the prior is known exactly, all statisticians will use Bayes’ formula. For Bayesian inference we take H to be a hypothesis and D some data. Over the last few weeks we have seen that, given a prior and a likelihood model, Bayes’ theorem is a complete recipe for updating our beliefs in the face of new data. This works perfectly when the prior was known perfectly. We saw this in our dice examples. We also saw examples of a disease with a known frequency in the general population and a screening test of known accuracy.

两派都接受贝叶斯定理. 当先验 P(H) 精确已知时, 大家都可以用它计算 P(H∣D).

前面的骰子例和疾病筛查就属于这种情况: 先验和似然模型都已给出, 贝叶斯定理提供了一套完整的更新规则. 分歧不是公式是否正确, 而是先验不明确时怎么办.

贝叶斯公式中的分母 P(D) 也要通过先验对所有假设加权得到. 因此缺少先验时, 不只是少一个乘法因子, 而是无法沿同一路径得到归一化后验.

频率派绕开这个困难, 直接比较不同假设下的 P(D∣H). 这让计算不依赖主观先验, 同时也不再输出假设的后验概率.

Page 2 (17a)

In practice we saw that there is usually no universally accepted prior – different people will have different a priori beliefs – but we would still like to make useful inferences from data. Bayesians and frequentists take fundamentally different approaches to this challenge, as summarized in the figure below.

The reasons for this split are both practical (ease of implementation and computation) and philosophical (subjectivity versus objectivity and the nature of probability).

现实中通常没有所有人一致接受的先验. 贝叶斯方法根据现有信息建立一个先验, 再计算后验; 频率派不为未知参数配先验, 只研究给定假设时数据的似然.

读图:上方是两派共用的概率公式, 下方才是统计推断的两条路径. 这种分岔既有计算和实施上的实际原因, 也有主观性、客观性和概率含义上的哲学原因.

2.2 概率是什么
2.2 What is probability?

Page 2 (17a)

The main philosophical difference concerns the meaning of probability. The term frequentist refers to the idea that probabilities represent long term frequencies of repeatable random experiments. For example, ‘a coin has probability 1/2 of heads’ means that the relative frequency of heads (number of heads out of number of flips) goes to 1/2 as the number of flips goes to infinity. This means the frequentist finds it nonsensical to specify a probability distribution for a parameter with a fixed value. While Bayesians are happy to use probability to describe their incomplete knowledge of a fixed parameter, frequentists reject the use of probability to quantify degree of belief in hypotheses.

频率派把概率理解为可重复随机试验的长期频率. 「正面概率为 1/2」指反复投掷时, 正面所占比例趋向 1/2.

在这种解释下, 固定参数不是随机变量, 给它指定先验分布没有意义. 贝叶斯方法则用概率描述对固定参数的不完整认识, 因此允许对参数和假设表达信念程度.

Page 2 (17a)

Example 1. Suppose I have a bent coin with unknown probability θ of heads. The value of θ may be unknown, but it is a fixed value. Thus, to the frequentist there can be no prior pdf f(θ). By comparison the Bayesian may agree that θ has a fixed value, but interprets f(θ) as representing uncertainty about that value. Both the Bayesian and the frequentist are perfectly happy with p(heads∣θ)=θ, since the longterm frequency of heads given θ is θ.

In short, Bayesians put probability distributions on everything (hypotheses and data), while frequentists put probability distributions on (random, repeatable, experimental) data given a hypothesis. For the frequentist when dealing with data from an unknown distribution only the likelihood has meaning. The prior and posterior do not.

弯曲硬币的 θ 虽然未知, 但在频率派看来是固定值, 所以没有先验 pdf f(θ). 贝叶斯方法也承认它固定, 只是用 f(θ) 表示我们对这个值的不确定性.

两派都接受 p(heads∣θ)=θ, 因为这是给定参数后数据发生的概率. 频率派拒绝的是 θ 自身的先验和后验, 不是拒绝似然 P(data∣θ).

可以把问题分成两层. 数据层是「若参数取这个值, 重复实验会怎样」; 参数层是「这个固定参数本身有多大的可能性」. 频率派只给第一层配概率, 贝叶斯方法两层都配.

因此频率派语境下不能把似然解释为参数的概率. ϕ(x∣θ) 仍然以 θ 为条件, 只是计算时可以把它看成随 θ 变化的函数, 用来比较不同假设.

疾病筛查回顾
Disease screening redux: probability; Disease screening redux: statistics

Slides 5–6

The test is positive. Are you sick?

H= sickH= healthy
P(H)0.0010.999
P(D∣H), D= pos. test0.990.01

The prior is known so we can use Bayes’ Theorem.

P(sick∣pos. test)=0.001⋅0.99+0.999⋅0.010.001⋅0.99​≈0.1.

The prior is not known.

Bayesian: use a subjective prior P(H) and Bayes’ Theorem.

Frequentist: the likelihood is all we can use: P(D∣H).

筛查例中, 患病率先验已知, 所以阳性后的患病概率可以直接用贝叶斯定理算出, 约为 0.1. 检验很准确也不等于阳性后必然患病, 因为健康人群的先验很大.

若患病率未知, 贝叶斯方法会选择一个主观先验继续算后验; 频率派则只使用阳性结果在患病或健康状态下的条件概率, 不给「是否患病」配先验.

这个例子清楚显示条件方向不能交换. P(阳性∣患病) 是检验准确度的一部分, P(患病∣阳性) 还依赖患病率. 频率派可以计算前者, 却不会在缺少先验时给后者一个数值.

Slide 7

Each day Jaam arrives X hours late to class, with X∼uniform(0,θ), where θ is unknown. Jon models his initial belief about θ by a prior pdf f(θ). After Jaam arrives x hours late to the next class, Jon computes the likelihood function ϕ(x∣θ) and the posterior pdf f(θ∣x).

Which of these probability computations would the frequentist consider valid?

  1. none
  2. prior
  3. likelihood
  4. posterior
  5. prior and posterior
  6. prior and likelihood
  7. likelihood and posterior
  8. prior, likelihood and posterior.

选 3. likelihood. 迟到时间 X 是可重复的随机数据, 给定 θ 后的分布和似然有频率意义.

先验和后验都给固定但未知的 θ 配概率分布, 因而不符合这里采用的频率派立场.

统计量与抽样分布
Statistics and Sampling Distributions

3 统计量的工作定义
3 Working definition of a statistic

Pages 2–3 (17a)

Our view of statistics is that it is the art of drawing conclusions (making inferences) from data. With that in mind we can make a simple working definition of a statistic. There is a more formal definition, but we don’t need to introduce it at this point.

Statistic. A statistic is anything that can be computed from data and known values. Sometimes to be more precise we’ll say a statistic is a rule for computing something from data and the value of the statistic is what is computed. This can include computing likelihoods where we hypothesize values of the model parameters. But it does not include anything that requires we know the true value of a model parameter with unknown value.

**statistic 统计量**的判别标准只有一条: 能否由数据和已知值算出. 它既可以指计算规则, 也可以指规则在某份数据上算出的值.

公式中出现参数并不意味着一定不是统计量. 如果参数被假设成某个已知常数, 就能计算; 如果必须知道真实但未知的参数值, 就不是统计量.

实际判断可以按顺序问三个问题: 数据是否已知? 式子里的其他常数是否给定? 代入这些值后能否得到唯一输出? 三个答案都是肯定, 才符合这个工作定义.

还要区分总体量与样本量. 总体均值和总体分位点通常依赖未知参数, 而样本均值和样本分位点直接从观察值计算; 名称相似不代表可计算性相同.

Page 3 (17a)

Examples. 1. The mean of data is a statistic. It is a rule that says given data x1​,…,xn​ compute nx1​+⋯+xn​​.

2. The maximum of data is a statistic. It is a rule that says to pick the maximum value of the data x1​,…,xn​.

3. Suppose x∼N(μ,32) where μ is unknown. Then the likelihood

ϕ(x∣μ=7)=32π​1​e−(x−7)2/18

is a statistic. However, the distance of x from the true mean μ is not a statistic since we cannot compute it without knowing μ.

样本均值和最大值都只用数据, 因而是统计量. 给定 μ=7 后的似然也能由 x 和已知数 7 算出.

但 x 到真实均值 μ 的距离需要知道那个未知的 μ, 所以不是统计量. 判断时要看表达式真正依赖什么, 而不是看它有没有希腊字母.

这里的似然把 μ 固定在 7 后, 仍然可以随着数据 x 改变而计算. 它不需要我们相信 7 就是真值, 只是把 7 当作一个明确假设来评价.

Page 3 (17a)

4. If our data x1​,…,xn​ is drawn from N(μ,32), where μ is unknown, then z=3/n​xˉ−5​ is a statistic, since it is computed from the data and known values. More generally, if μ0​ is a known value then z=3/n​xˉ−μ0​​ is a statistic. However, since μ is not known, z=3/n​xˉ−μ​ is not a statistic.

Note. We will usually stick with our Bayesian practice of using the symbol ϕ for continuous likelihoods. This will help remind us that Frequentists don’t have prior and posterior probabilities for hypotheses.

(xˉ−5)/(3/n​) 使用已知常数 5 和 3, 所以是统计量; 把 5 换成已知假设值 μ0​ 也一样.

但若减去真实未知均值 μ, 就无法仅从数据算出, 所以不是统计量. 后面的检验总是使用假设值 μ0​, 不会把未知的真值代入公式.

Page 3 (17a)

Point statistic. A point statistic is a single value computed from data. For example, the mean and the maximum are both point statistics. The maximum likelihood estimate is also a point statistic since it is computed directly from the data based on a likelihood model.

Interval statistic. An interval statistic is an interval computed from data. For example, the range from the minimum to maximum of x1​,…,xn​ is an interval statistic, e.g. the data 0.5, 1.0, 0.2, 3.0, 5.0 has range [0.2,5.0].

**point statistic 点统计量**是一个数, 如均值、最大值和最大似然估计. **interval statistic 区间统计量**是一个由数据算出的区间.

给定数据 0.5、1.0、0.2、3.0、5.0, 最小值与最大值形成区间 [0.2,5.0]. 端点随样本变化, 所以整个区间也是随机的.

Page 3 (17a)

Set statistic. A set statistic is a set computed from data.

Example. Suppose we have five dice: 4, 6, 8, 12 and 20-sided. We pick one at random and roll it once. The value of the roll is the data. The set of dice for which this roll is possible is a set statistic. For example, if the roll is a 10 then the value of this set statistic is {12,20}. If the roll is a 7 then this set statistic has value {8,12,20}.

**set statistic 集合统计量**的输出是一整个集合. 掷出 10 时, 只有 12 面和 20 面骰子可能产生它, 所以统计量的值是 {12,20}.

掷出 7 时对应集合变为 {8,12,20}. 这说明统计量不一定是数值, 关键是输出能否由数据确定.

这个集合还可以看成一次简单的模型筛选: 与观察结果不相容的骰子被排除, 相容的留下. 后面的拒绝域也是按数据把某些决定归类, 只是那里通常以数值统计量和尾概率来表达.

Page 3 (17a)

It’s important to remember that a statistic is itself a random variable since it is computed from random data. For example, if data is drawn from N(μ,σ2) then the mean of n data points follows the distribution N(μ,σ2/n)).

Sampling distribution. The probability distribution of a statistic is called its sampling distribution.

Point estimate. We can use statistics to make a point estimate of a parameter θ. For example, if our data is drawn from a normal distribution with unknown mean θ. Then the data mean xˉ is a point estimate of θ.

数据随机, 由数据算出的统计量也随机. 它在重复抽样中的概率分布叫 **sampling distribution 抽样分布**.

例如正态样本的均值服从 N(μ,σ2/n), 样本量越大, 均值分布越集中. 某一份数据算出的 xˉ 则可用作未知参数 θ 的 **point estimate 点估计**.

「抽样分布」强调重复抽样的思想: 每一次新样本都会给出一个新的统计量值, 这些值的理论分布才是抽样分布. 它不是把当前样本内部的经验分布换个名字.

后面的零分布就是检验统计量在 H0​ 下的抽样分布. 理解了这一点, 显著性和 p 值都只是在同一张重复抽样图景中计算尾概率.

原文笔误:样本均值分布末尾写成 N(μ,σ²/n)), 多一个右括号, 应为 N(μ,σ2/n).

Slide 9

Suppose x1​,…,xn​ is a sample from N(μ,σ2), where μ and σ are unknown. Is each of the following a statistic?

  1. The median of x1​,…,xn​.
  2. The interval from the 0.25 quantile to the 0.75 quantile of N(μ,σ2).
  3. The standardized mean σ/n​xˉ−μ​.
  4. The set of sample values less than 1 unit from xˉ.
  5. The z=3/n​xˉ−5​.
  6. z=σ0​/n​xˉ−μ0​​, where μ0​ and σ0​ are given values.

(a) 是; (b) 不是, 总体分位点依赖未知的 μ,σ; (c) 不是, 含真实未知参数; (d) 是, 样本均值和样本值都可算; (e) 是; (f) 是.

易错:(e) 虽然原模型写未知 μ,σ, 但这个式子已经改用已知常数 5 和 3, 不依赖它们的真实值. (b) 问的是理论分布的分位区间, 不是样本分位区间.

原假设显著性检验的要素
The Ingredients of Null Hypothesis Significance Testing

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1 (17b)
  1. Know the definitions of the significance testing terms: null hypothesis, alternative hypothesis, NHST, simple hypothesis, composite hypothesis, significance level, power.
  2. Be able to design and run a significance test for Bernoulli or binomial data.
  3. Be able to compute a p-value for a normal hypothesis and use it in a significance test.

第二份讲义要掌握 NHST 的基本术语, 能为 Bernoulli 或二项数据设计检验, 并计算正态假设下的 p 值.

术语会围绕同一个硬币例反复出现. 学习时始终分清「假设是什么」「统计量怎样分布」「哪些结果算极端」.

整份讲义可以按一条计算链来读: 由 H0​ 得到零分布, 由 HA​ 决定尾部方向, 由 α 确定拒绝域, 再由实际数据计算统计量与 p 值, 最后在具体备择参数下评价功效.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1 (17b)

Frequentist statistics is often applied in the framework of null hypothesis significance testing (NHST). We will look at the Neyman-Pearson paradigm which focuses on one hypothesis called the null hypothesis. There are other paradigms for hypothesis testing, but Neyman-Pearson is the most common. Stated simply, this method asks if the data is well outside the region where we would expect to see it under the null hypothesis. If so, then we reject the null hypothesis in favor of a second hypothesis called the alternative hypothesis. The reasoning is that such extreme data is very unlikely in a world where the null hypothesis is true.

We have said before that statistics is an art. We will see that this statement is certainly valid when we discuss choosing null and alternative hypotheses.

**null hypothesis significance testing (NHST) 原假设显著性检验**先假定 H0​ 为真, 再看实际数据是否落在它很难产生的区域. 若结果足够极端, 就拒绝 H0​, 转向备择假设 HA​.

它计算的是 P(极端数据∣H0​), 不是 P(H0​∣数据). 选择什么作为默认假设和备择假设, 也包含研究背景与惯例, 不纯粹是代数.

Neyman-Pearson 范式把决策规则预先固定下来: 哪些结果出现就拒绝, 哪些结果出现就不拒绝. 这样可以事先计算规则在重复实验中的错误率, 而不是看完数据后临时改变标准.

「极端」也不等于数值一定很大. 它指与 H0​ 的预期不符、同时更符合备择方向的结果; 左尾、右尾或双尾都由这个逻辑决定.

拒绝 H0​ 同样不是绝对证明它为假. 即便原假设为真, 极端结果仍可能偶尔发生, 只是我们把这种误判的长期概率预先控制在 α 以内.

Page 1 (17b)

The computations done here all involve the likelihood function. There are two main differences between what we’ll do here and what we did in Bayesian updating.

  1. The evidence of the data will be considered purely through the likelihood function: it will not be weighted by our prior beliefs.
  2. We will need a notion of extreme data, e.g. 95 out of 100 heads in a coin toss or a mayfly that lives for a month.

There are seemingly a lot of terms with similar definitions. If you pay careful attention to the figures and how they are shaded and labeled we think you will find that is not so complicated.

NHST 与贝叶斯更新有两个直接差别. 第一, 证据只通过似然进入, 不乘先验; 第二, 必须事先定义什么叫「极端数据」.

例如 100 次中 95 次正面, 或蜉蝣活了一个月, 都需要参照某个零模型判断罕见程度. 图中的阴影和标签正是在区分这些概率到底对应哪个分布、哪片区域.

2.2 动机例
2.2 Motivating examples

Pages 1–2 (17b)

Example 1. Suppose you want to decide whether a coin is fair. If you toss it 100 times and get 85 heads, would you think the coin is likely to be unfair? What about 60 heads? Or 52 heads? Most people would guess that 85 heads is strong evidence that the coin is unfair, whereas 52 heads is no evidence at all. Sixty heads is less clear. Null hypothesis significance testing (NHST) is a frequentist approach to thinking quantitatively about these questions.

Example 2. Suppose you want to compare a new medical treatment to a placebo or to the current standard of care. What sort of evidence would convince you that the new treatment is better than the placebo or the current standard? Again, NHST is a quantitative framework for answering these questions.

100 次投掷中 85 次正面通常显得很不公平, 52 次则接近公平硬币的预期, 60 次比较模糊. NHST 要把这种直觉转成可计算的概率与拒绝规则.

不能只说「85 很多, 所以拒绝」. 正式检验还要说明在公平硬币下, 得到至少这么极端结果的概率是多少, 以及这个概率是否低于事先选定的门槛.

医学比较也类似: 需要明确「没有改进」的默认模型, 再判断观察到的改善在该模型下是否太罕见.

3.1 检验的组成
3.1 Ingredients

Page 2 (17b)

We’ll start by listing the ingredients for NHST. Formally they are pretty simple. There is an art to choosing good ingredients. We will explore the art in examples. If you have never seen NHST before just scan this list now and come back to it after reading through the examples and explanations given below.

  • H0​: the null hypothesis. This is the default assumption for the model generating the data.
  • HA​: the alternative hypothesis. If we reject the null hypothesis we accept this alternative as the best explanation for the data.
  • X: the test statistic. We compute this from the data. It is a random variable, because it is computed from random data.

**null hypothesis 原假设**是默认的数据生成模型, **alternative hypothesis 备择假设**描述我们希望识别的偏离. 二者角色不同: 检验先保护原假设, 只有证据足够强才拒绝它.

**test statistic 检验统计量**把整份数据压缩成一个用于判断的量, 例如正面次数或样本均值. 它必须能由数据和已知值计算, 而且会随样本随机变化.

选择统计量时要保留与问题有关的信息. 研究正面比例就看正面次数, 研究均值差异就看均值或标准化均值.

Page 2 (17b)
  • Null distribution: the probability distribution of X assuming H0​.
  • Rejection region: if X is in the rejection region we reject H0​ in favor of HA​.
  • Non-rejection region: the complement to the rejection region. If X is in this region we do not reject H0​. Note that we say ‘do not reject’ rather than ‘accept’ because usually the best we can say is that the data does not support rejecting H0​.

The null hypothesis H0​ and the alternative hypothesis HA​ play different roles. Typically we choose H0​ to be either a simple hypothesis or the default which we’ll only reject if we have enough evidence against it. The examples below will clarify this.

**null distribution 零分布**是在 H0​ 下检验统计量的抽样分布. 它提供一把尺子, 用来判断实际结果是否罕见; 不是实际样本本身的直方图.

统计量落入 **rejection region 拒绝域**就拒绝 H0​, 落入其补集就不拒绝. 拒绝域应根据备择方向设计, 但其中的概率始终按零分布计算.

「不拒绝」只表示证据不足, 不等于证明 H0​ 为真. 样本量太小或功效太低时, 真实效应也可能没有被检出.

硬币例: 拒绝域与显著性
Coin Example: Rejection Region and Significance

4 NHST 术语
4 NHST Terminology

Pages 2–3 (17b)

Example 3. To test whether a coin is fair we flip it 10 times. If we get an unexpectedly large or small number of heads we’ll suspect the coin is unfair. To make this precise in the language of NHST we set up the ingredients as follows. Let θ be the probability that the coin lands heads when flipped.

  1. Null hypothesis: H0​= ‘the coin is fair’, i.e. θ=0.5.
  2. Alternative hypothesis: HA​= ‘the coin is not fair’, i.e. θ=0.5.
  3. Test statistic: X= number of heads in 10 flips.
  4. Null distribution: This is the probability function based on the null hypothesis
    p(x∣θ=0.5)∼binomial(10,0.5).
  5. Rejection region: under the null hypothesis we expect to get about 5 heads in 10 tosses. Whereas, under the alternate hypothesis we expect the number of heads to be biased either above or below 5. So, we’ll reject H0​ in favor of HA​ if the number of heads is much fewer or greater than 5. Let’s set the rejection region as {0,1,2,8,9,10}. That is, if the number of heads in 10 tosses is in this region we will reject the hypothesis that the coin is fair in favor of the hypothesis that it is not.

硬币例设 H0​:θ=0.5, HA​:θ=0.5, 检验统计量是 10 次中的正面数 X. 零分布因此是二项分布 Binomial(10,0.5).

备择允许偏向正面或反面, 所以拒绝域要覆盖两端: {0,1,2,8,9,10}. 中间的 3 到 7 次正面不构成足够强的反对证据.

零分布为二项分布是因为 H0​ 已把每次正面概率固定为 0.5, 并沿用独立投掷模型. 任一具体正面次数 x 的概率由 (x10​)(0.5)10 给出.

拒绝域并不是把概率最小的单个结果机械拼起来, 还要考虑备择方向. 这里过多和过少正面都支持「不公平」, 所以两端都纳入.

Page 3 (17b)

We can summarize all this in the graph and probability table below. The rejection region consists of those values of x in orange, i.e. 0, 1, 2, 8, 9, 10. The probabilities corresponding to it are shaded in orange. We also show the null distribution as a stem plot with the rejection values of x in orange.

Notes for Example 3:

  1. The null hypothesis is the cautious default: we won’t claim the coin is unfair unless we have compelling evidence.
  2. The rejection region consists of data that is extreme under the null hypothesis and more likely under the alternative hypothesis. That is, it consists of the outcomes that are in the tail of the null distribution away from the high probability center. As we’ll discuss soon, how far away depends on the significance level α of the test.
  3. If we get 3 heads in 10 tosses, then the test statistic is in the non-rejection region. The usual scientific language would be to say that the data ‘does not support rejecting the null hypothesis’. Even if we got 5 heads, we would not claim that the data proves the null hypothesis is true.

图中橙色标出两端的拒绝取值及其零分布概率. 拒绝域位于低概率尾部, 因为这些结果在公平硬币下少见, 在不公平硬币下更合理.

得到 3 次正面时不拒绝, 得到 5 次也不能说证明了公平. 原假设只是谨慎的默认, 检验主要寻找反对它的证据, 不是直接证明它.

不拒绝的结果可以有很多种解释: 硬币确实公平, 或者不公平但偏差不大, 或者样本太少而没有检出. 仅凭一次不拒绝无法区分这些情况.

Page 4 (17b)

Question: If we have a fair coin what is the probability that we will decide incorrectly it is unfair?

Solution: The null hypothesis is that the coin is fair. The question asks for the probability the data from a fair coin will be in the rejection region. That is, the probability that we will get 0, 1, 2, 8, 9 or 10 heads in 10 tosses. This is the sum of the probabilities in the table in shaded orange boxes. That is,

P(rejecting H0​∣H0​ is true)=0.11.

问题问的是公平硬币被误判为不公平的概率, 因此要在 θ=0.5 的零分布下, 把 0、1、2、8、9、10 的概率全部相加.

精确值为 112/1024=0.109375≈0.11. 它不是某一个观测值的概率, 也不是 H0​ 为真的概率, 而是 H0​ 为真时落入整个拒绝域的概率.

这个 112 来自两端组合数之和: 左侧 0,1,2 次正面对应 (010​)+(110​)+(210​), 右侧与之对称. 分母 1024=210 是等可能序列总数.

换句话说, 即使硬币完全公平, 按这套规则重复做实验, 长期仍约有 10.9% 会被误判为不公平. 这就是第一类错误概率的具体含义.

简单假设与复合假设
Simple and Composite Hypotheses

4.1 简单与复合假设
4.1 Simple and composite hypotheses

Page 4 (17b)

Definition: simple hypothesis: A simple hypothesis is one for which we can specify its distribution completely. A typical simple hypothesis is that a parameter of interest takes a specific value.

Definition: composite hypotheses: If its distribution cannot be fully specified, we say that the hypothesis is composite. A typical composite hypothesis is that a parameter of interest lies in a range of values.

In Example 3 the null hypothesis is that θ=0.5, so the null distribution is binomial(10, 0.5). Since the null distribution is fully specified, H0​ is simple. The alternative hypothesis is that θ=0.5. This is really many hypotheses in one: θ could be 0.51, 0.7, 0.99, etc. Since the alternative distribution binomial(10, θ) is not fully specified, HA​ is composite.

**simple hypothesis 简单假设**能唯一确定一个分布, 例如 θ=0.5. **composite hypothesis 复合假设**包含一族分布, 例如 θ>0.5 或 θ=0.5.

例 3 的零分布可以完整写成 Binomial(10,0.5), 所以 H0​ 简单. 备择没有指定唯一 θ, 每个参数值又对应不同分布, 所以 HA​ 复合.

简单原假设特别方便, 因为它给出唯一零分布, 可以直接计算拒绝域概率. 复合备择则意味着功效必须随具体参数值逐个计算, 不能只报一个脱离参数的功效.

「复合」不等于一定包含无限多个假设. 即使只包含两个未完全指定的可能模型, 只要不能唯一确定分布, 也仍是复合假设.

Page 4 (17b)

Example 4. Suppose we have data x1​,…,xn​. Suppose also that our hypotheses are

H0​: the data is drawn from N(0,1),HA​: the data is drawn from N(1,1).

These are both simple hypotheses – each hypothesis completely specifies a distribution.

Example 5. (Composite hypotheses.) Now suppose that our hypotheses are

H0​: the data is drawn from a Poisson distribution of unknown parameter,HA​: the data is not drawn from a Poisson distribution.

These are both composite hypotheses, as they don’t fully specify the distribution.

N(0,1) 与 N(1,1) 都把均值和方差写全了, 所以两个假设都是简单假设.

「某个未知参数的泊松分布」仍包含许多分布, 「不是泊松分布」包含的分布更多, 因此两者都是复合假设. 简单与否取决于分布是否完全确定, 不取决于语句长短.

Page 4 (17b)

Example 6. In an ESP experiment a subject is asked to identify the suits of 100 cards drawn (with replacement) from a deck of cards. Let T be the number of successes. The (simple) null hypothesis that the subject does not have ESP is given by H0​:T∼binomial(100,0.25). The (composite) alternative hypothesis that the subject has ESP is given by HA​:T∼binomial(100,p) with p>0.25. Another (composite) alternative hypothesis that something besides pure chance is going on, i.e. the subject has ESP or anti-ESP, is given by HA​:T∼binomial(100,p), with p=0.25. Values of p<0.25 represent hypotheses that the subject has a kind of anti-esp.

没有 ESP 时, 猜中花色的概率为 0.25, 所以零分布唯一. 有 ESP 对应 p>0.25, 是右尾复合备择.

若允许 ESP 或 anti-ESP, 就用 p=0.25, 检验变为双尾. 备择假设的方向决定哪些结果算支持备择的极端结果.

若研究问题只关心「是否比随机猜得更好」, 极高的成功次数才符合备择, 应采用右尾. 若也关心「是否系统性地比随机猜更差」, 极低成功次数同样提供信息, 就应保留两端.

所以单双尾不是根据结果显著与否来选择, 而是由研究问题是否包含两个方向的偏离来决定.

两类错误、显著性与功效
Types of Error, Significance Level and Power

4.2 两类错误
4.2 Types of error

Page 5 (17b)

There are two types of errors we can make. We can incorrectly reject the null hypothesis when it is true or we can incorrectly fail to reject it when it is false. These are unimaginatively labeled type I and type II errors. We summarize this in the following table.

True state of nature
Our decisionH0​HA​
Reject H0​Type I errorcorrect decision
‘Don’t reject’ H0​correct decisionType II error

Type I: false rejection of H0​

Type II: false non-rejection (‘acceptance’) of H0​

**type I error 第一类错误**是 H0​ 为真却拒绝它; **type II error 第二类错误**是 HA​ 为真却没有拒绝 H0​.

表格要按「真实情况」和「检验决定」交叉阅读. 错误名称描述的是决定与事实怎样不一致, 不是说 H0​ 或 HA​ 本身犯错.

4.3 显著性水平与功效
4.3 Significance level and power

Page 5 (17b)

Significance level and power are used to quantify the quality of the significance test. Ideally a significance test would not make errors. That is, it would not reject H0​ when H0​ was true and would reject H0​ in favor of HA​ when HA​ was true. Altogether there are 4 important probabilities corresponding to the 2×2 table just above.

P(reject H0​∣H0​)P(reject H0​∣HA​)
P(do not reject H0​∣H0​)P(do not reject H0​∣HA​)

The two probabilities we focus on are:

Significance level=P(reject H0​∣H0​)=P(type I error),
Power=P(reject H0​∣HA​)=1−P(type II error).

Ideally, a hypothesis test should have a small significance level (near 0) and a large power (near 1).

**significance level 显著性水平** α 是 H0​ 为真时拒绝它的概率. **power 功效**是 HA​ 为真时成功拒绝 H0​ 的概率, 等于 1−β, 其中 β 是第二类错误概率.

理想检验希望 α 接近 0、功效接近 1. 条件方向要看清: α 条件于 H0​, 功效条件于 HA​, 二者都不是假设自身的后验概率.

在同一模型和样本量下, 缩小拒绝域通常会降低 α, 却也更容易漏掉真实效应, 使功效下降. 扩大拒绝域则相反. 设计检验是在两类错误之间作权衡.

若希望同时降低两类错误, 通常需要更好的数据或更大的样本量, 使零分布与备择分布更容易区分, 而不是只移动临界值.

Page 5 (17b)

Some analogies

  1. Think of H0​ as the hypothesis ‘nothing noteworthy is going on’, i.e. ‘the coin is fair’, ‘the treatment is no better than placebo’ etc. And think of HA​ as the opposite: ‘something interesting is happening’. Then power is the probability of detecting something interesting when it’s present and significance level is the probability of mistakenly claiming something interesting has occured.
  2. In the U.S. criminal defendents are presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. We can phrase this in NHST terms as H0​: the defendent is innocent (the default), HA​: the defendent is guilty. Significance level is the probability of finding an innocent person guilty. Power is the probability of correctly finding a guilty party guilty. ‘Beyond a reasonable doubt’ means we should demand the significance level be very small.

把 H0​ 想成「没有值得注意的效应」, 显著性就是没事却误报有事, 功效则是确实有事时成功检出.

法庭类比中, H0​ 是被告无罪. 显著性对应误判无罪者有罪, 功效对应正确判定有罪者. 「排除合理怀疑」要求把误判概率压得很小, 但不能只看功效而忽略第一类错误.

显著性仍然不是「被告实际上无罪的概率」, 功效也不是「被告实际上有罪的概率」. 两者都描述在某一种事实前提下, 检验作出某项决定的频率.

原文笔误:occured 应为 occurred; 三处 defendent(s) 应为 defendant(s). 后文 probabilitiy 应为 probability.

复合备择下的功效
Composite hypotheses

Page 6 (17b)

HA​ is composite in Example 3, so the power is different for different values of θ. We expand the previous probability table to include some alternate values of θ. We do the same with the stem plots. As always in the NHST game, we look at likelihoods: the probability of the data given a hypothesis.

The rejection range consists of the extreme values of x. The non-rejection range (3-7) is a set of center values of x.

We use the probability table to compute the significance level and power of this test.

  • Significance level = probability we reject H0​ when it is true = sum of shaded orange boxes in the θ=0.5 row = 0.11.
  • Power when θ=0.6 = probability we reject H0​ when θ=0.6 = sum of blue boxes in the θ=0.6 row = 0.180.
  • Power when θ=0.7 = probability we reject H0​ when θ=0.7 = sum of blue boxes in the θ=0.7 row = 0.384.

We see that the power is greater for θ=0.7 than for θ=0.6. This isn’t surprising since we expect it to be easier to recognize that a 0.7 coin is unfair than is is to recognize 0.6 coin is unfair. Typically, we get higher power when the alternate hypothesis is farther from the null hypothesis. In Example 3, it would be quite hard to distinguish a fair coin from one with θ=0.51.

拒绝域固定后, 显著性只在 θ=0.5 这一行求和; 功效要在具体的备择参数行求和. 复合备择没有唯一功效, 应说「在 θ=0.6 时功效为 0.180」.

备择离原假设越远, 通常越容易检出, 所以 θ=0.7 的功效高于 θ=0.6. 若真实 θ=0.51, 它的分布与公平硬币非常接近, 同样样本量下就很难识别.

读图时先选定一行分布, 再看同一组拒绝取值. 行变了, 每个取值的概率都会变, 所以不能把零分布的 0.11 当成所有参数下的拒绝概率.

双尾备择还包括 θ<0.5 的情形. 对称地, 正面概率特别小时也会更容易落入左尾拒绝域, 功效取决于偏离 0.5 的方向和幅度.

原文笔误:than is is to recognize 0.6 coin 中重复 is, 且 0.6 coin 前缺 a.

拒绝域与功效的图像
Conceptual Sketches of Rejection and Power

4.4.1 零分布下的拒绝与不拒绝
4.4.1 Null distribution: rejection and non-rejection regions

Page 7 (17b)

We illustrate the notions of null hypothesis, rejection region and power with some sketches of the pdfs for the null and alternative hypotheses.

The test statistic x1​ is in the non-rejection region. So, if our data produced the test statistic x1​ then we would not reject the null hypothesis H0​. On the other hand the test statistic x2​ is in the rejection region, so if our data produced x2​ then we would reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis.

  1. The rejection region consists of values far from the center of the null distribution.
  2. The rejection region is two-sided. We will also see examples of one-sided rejection regions as well.
  3. The probability of rejection (significance) is the shaded area under the curve, i.e. the probability of data being in the rejection region assuming H0​ is true.

观察统计量落在中央就不拒绝, 落在两端就拒绝. 拒绝域位于零分布的低概率尾部, 本图是双尾, 其他检验也可以只用一侧.

显著性是零分布曲线在拒绝域上的面积, 不是拒绝域的横轴长度. 即使两个区域一样宽, 密度形状不同也会给出不同概率.

图中判断只问一件事: 若 H0​ 为真, 统计量落在这片区域的概率是多少.

Page 7 (17b)
  1. The alternative hypothesis is not mentioned. We reject or don’t reject H0​ based only on the likelihood ϕ(x∣H0​), i.e. the probability of the test statistic conditioned on H0​. As we will see, the alternative hypothesis HA​ should be considered when choosing a rejection region, but formally it does not play a role in rejecting or not rejecting H0​.
  2. Sometimes we rather lazily call the non-rejection region the acceptance region. This is technically incorrect because we never truly accept the null hypothesis. We either reject or say the data does not support rejecting H0​. This is often summarized by the statement: you can never prove the null hypothesis.

备择假设参与「怎样选拒绝域」, 但决定是否拒绝时, 概率只按 H0​ 计算. 右尾备择引导我们把拒绝域放在右边, 双尾备择引导我们关注两端.

不把不拒绝域称为接受域更准确, 因为检验没有证明原假设. 数据与 H0​ 相容, 只说明它没有达到拒绝标准, 并不排除其他也与数据相容的模型.

4.4.2 高功效与低功效检验
4.4.2 High and low power tests

Pages 7–8 (17b)

The next two figures show high and low power tests. In both tests the null distributions are standard normal. Likewise, the alternative distributions are both normal with variance 1, but different means: -4.0 in the top figure and -0.4 in the bottom one.

Since the alternative distribution is to the left of the null distribution we use a one-sided rejection region. It is the same for both tests. The shaded area under ϕ(x∣H0​) represents the significance level – it is the same for both tests. The shaded area under ϕ(x∣HA​) represents the power.

两图的零分布和拒绝域相同, 所以显著性相同. 上图备择均值为 -4, 下图为 -0.4, 两者都在零分布左侧, 因而采用同一个左尾拒绝域.

差别在备择曲线下落入拒绝域的面积. 上图分离明显, 功效高; 下图重叠很大, 功效低.

两图的显著性相同并不矛盾. 显著性只看零分布和固定拒绝域, 这两者没有改变; 功效还取决于备择分布的位置, 所以会随着均值间距改变.

因此评价一个检验不能只报 α=0.05. 还要问对多远的效应有多大概率检出, 否则可能是一个错误率很低、却很难发现真实效应的检验.

Pages 8–9 (17b)

Both tests have the same significance level, but different powers. When ϕ(x∣HA​) has considerable overlap with ϕ(x∣H0​) the power will tend to be low and when they are well separated it tends to be high.

In the top figure we see that the means of the null and alternative distributions are 4 standard deviations apart. Since the areas under the densities have very little overlap the test has high power. That is, if HA​ was true, then seeing the data x3​ would be rare and surprising and similarly for any point in the non-rejection region. That is, if HA​ is the true distribution we are extremely likely to correctly reject the null hypothesis, i.e. we are unlikely to make a type II error.

In the bottom figure we see that the means of the null and alternative distributions are just 0.4 standard deviations apart. Since the areas under the densities have a lot of overlap the test has low power. That is, if the data x is drawn from HA​ it is highly likely to be in the non-rejection region. For example x3​ would be not be a very surprising outcome for the HA​ distribution. That is, if HA​ is the true distribution, we are highly likely to make a type II error.

上图两条曲线均值相差 4 个标准差, 备择分布大部分落在拒绝域内, 所以第二类错误很少. 下图只差 0.4 个标准差, 大量备择数据仍落在不拒绝域.

因此, 不拒绝并不总是说明没有效应. 在低功效检验中, 即使备择为真, 得到落在中央的数据也很常见.

效应大小与分布宽度要放在一起看. 同样相差 0.4, 若标准差很大就难分, 若标准误因样本量增加而变小, 同样的均值差就会变得容易识别.

高功效也不是保证某一次一定拒绝, 而是说在备择为真时, 正确拒绝的长期概率较高.

Page 9 (17b)

Typically we can increase the power of a test by increasing the amount of data and thereby decreasing the variance of the null and alternative distributions. In experimental design it is important to determine ahead of time the number of trials or subjects needed to achieve a desired power.

Example 7. Suppose a drug for a disease is being compared to a placebo. We choose our null and alternative hypotheses as H0​= the drug does not work better than the placebo, HA​= the drug works better than the placebo. The power of the hypothesis test is the probability that the test will conclude that the drug is better, if it is indeed truly better. The significance level is the probability that the test will conclude that the drug works better, when in fact it does not.

增加样本量会使样本统计量的分布更窄, 在效应不变时减少零分布与备择分布的重叠, 因此通常能提高功效.

功效分析应在试验前用于确定样本量. 药物例中, 功效是药物确实更好时检验能发现它的概率; 显著性则是药物并不好时却误判它更好的概率.

设计时可以指定一个有实际意义的效应大小, 再计算达到目标功效所需的人数. 若只做几十次试验却希望可靠识别极小效应, 往往会得到低功效和大量不拒绝结果.

Slide 15

The null and alternate pdfs are shown on the following plot.

The significance level of the test is given by the area of which region?

  1. R1​
  2. R3​
  3. R1​+R2​
  4. R2​+R3​+R4​
  5. R2​
  6. R4​
  7. R2​+R3​
  8. None of these

选 3. R1​+R2​. 显著性只沿 ϕ(x∣H0​) 在拒绝域内积分, 所以包括左尾主体 R1​ 和两曲线重叠处仍属于零分布的 R2​.

R3​ 属于备择曲线下方的面积, 不计入 α. 重叠区域要按「属于哪条曲线」拆分, 不能只看几何外形.

如果改问功效, 就要改用备择曲线, 在同一拒绝域上累计它下方的面积. 同一块图形区域可以因参照分布不同而对应不同概率.

设计检验与选择显著性水平
Designing a Hypothesis Test

5 设计假设检验
5 Designing a hypothesis test

Page 9 (17b)

Formally all a hypothesis test requires is H0​, HA​, a test statistic and a rejection region. In practice the design is often done using the following steps.

  1. Pick the null hypothesis H0​. The choice of H0​ and HA​ is not mathematics. It’s art and custom. We often choose H0​ to be simple. Or we often choose H0​ to be the simplest or most cautious explanation, i.e. no effect of drug, no ESP, no bias in the coin.
  2. Decide if HA​ is one-sided or two-sided. In Example 3 we wanted to know if the coin was unfair. An unfair coin could be biased for or against heads, so HA​:θ=0.5 is a two-sided hypothesis. If we only care whether or not the coin is biased for heads we could use the one-sided hypothesis HA​:θ>0.5.
  3. Pick a test statistic. For example, the sample mean, sample total, or sample variance. Some standard statistics that we will encounter are z, t, and χ2. The distributions that go with these statistics are always conditioned on the null hypothesis. That is, we will compute likelihoods such as ϕ(z∣H0​).

设计先做三项选择: 原假设通常取简单、谨慎的默认; 备择按研究问题决定单尾或双尾; 检验统计量可选均值、总数、方差或标准统计量 z,t,χ2.

这些选择不能完全由数据代替. 尤其是单双尾应由研究问题预先决定, 不能看完结果偏向哪边再改.

「没有效应」常被选为 H0​, 是因为它提供明确的基准模型, 也符合谨慎推断: 没有足够证据时, 不宣布新发现. 但这不表示研究者相信它一定为真.

统计量的分布必须以 H0​ 为条件, 才能给出统一的尾概率尺度. 如果零分布都未确定, 就无法判断什么结果算罕见.

Pages 9–10 (17b)
  1. Pick a significance level and determine the rejection region. We will usually use α to denote the significance level. The Neyman-Pearson paradigm is to pick α in advance. Typical values are 0.1, 0.05, 0.01. Recall that the significance level is the probability of a type I error. The value we choose will depend on the consequences of a type I error. Once the significance level is chosen we can determine the rejection region in the tail(s) of the null distribution.
  2. Determine the power(s). As we saw in Example 3, once the rejection region is set we can determine the power of the test at various values of the alternate hypothesis.

In Example 3, if we set α=0.05 then the rejection region must contain at most 0.05 probability. For a two-sided rejection region this is split between the two tails, so we get {0,1,9,10}. If we set α=0.01 the rejection region is {0,10}.

Suppose we change HA​ to ‘the coin is biased in favor of heads’. We now have a one-sided hypothesis θ>0.5. Our rejection region will now be in the right-hand tail. Now if α=0.05 the rejection region is {9,10}. If we set α=0.01 then the rejection region is {10}.

第 4 步先定 α, 再在零分布尾部确定拒绝域; 第 5 步才计算具体备择参数下的功效. α 应在看结果前确定, 防止根据数据事后挑门槛.

双尾把允许的错误概率分到两端, 单尾只放在备择方向那一端. 同样的 α, 改变备择方向就会改变拒绝域.

单尾右尾检验中, 极少的正面不支持 θ>0.5, 所以即使它在零分布下罕见, 也不会被放进这个备择方向的拒绝域. 「罕见」与「支持备择」必须同时考虑.

Page 10 (17b)

We show these in tables with the rejection region (values of x) inside the orange rectangle and the corresponding null likelihoods in the shaded orange boxes.

As above we show the one sided rejection regions in tables.

离散分布不能任意凑出恰好 0.05. 双尾区域 {0,1,9,10} 的实际显著性约为 0.02148, 是「至多 0.05」, 不是恰好 0.05.

再把 2 和 8 加入, 零分布概率就会超过 0.05. 单尾区域也受同样的离散跳跃限制, 所以临界取值只能按概率阈值选择.

因此「显著性水平为 0.05」在离散检验里常表示名义上限. 实际第一类错误概率可以更小, 不能为了凑到恰好 0.05 而随意加入不合适的中心结果.

这也说明拒绝域的边界是离散的整数, 不能像正态分布那样在连续横轴上任意放置.

Pages 10–11 (17b)

Example 8. (Consequences of significance) If α=0.1 then we’d expect a 10% type I error rate. That is, we expect to reject the null hypothesis in 10% of those experiments where the null hypothesis is true. Whether 0.1 is a reasonable signficance level depends on the decisions that will be made using it.

For example, if you were running an experiment to determine if your chocolate is more than 72% cocoa then a 10% error type I error rate is probably okay. That is, falsely believing some 72% chocalate is greater that 72%, is probably acceptable. On the other hand, if your forensic lab is identifying fingerprints for a murder trial then a 10% type I error rate, i.e. mistakenly claiming that fingerprints found at the crime scene belonged to someone who was truly innocent, is definitely not acceptable.

Significance for a composite null hypothesis. If H0​ is composite then P(type I error) depends on which member of H0​ is true. In this case the significance level is defined as the maximum of these probabilities.

α=0.1 表示在原假设为真的重复实验中, 长期约有 10% 被错误拒绝. 是否合理取决于误报后果, 巧克力标签与谋杀案指纹显然不能用同一标准.

复合原假设下, 不同参数会产生不同第一类错误概率, 显著性取它们的最大值, 从而控制最坏情况.

这样定义的 α 给出统一保证: 无论真值落在复合 H0​ 的哪个成员上, 错误拒绝概率都不超过这个最大值. 若只取某一个方便参数计算, 就可能低估其他成员的风险.

原文笔误:signficance 应为 significance, chocalate 应为 chocolate, greater that 72% 应为 greater than 72%; a 10% error type I error rate 多一个 error. 幻灯片同类题中 significanc、fin 分别应为 significance、find.

临界值与拒绝域
Critical Values and Rejection Regions

6 临界值
6 Critical values

Page 11 (17b)

Critical values are like quantiles except they refer to the probability to the right of the value instead of the left.

Example 9. Use R to find the 0.05 critical value for the standard normal distribution.

Solution: We label this critical value z0.05​. The critical value z0.05​ is just the 0.95 quantile, i.e. it has 5% probability to its right and therefore 95% probability to its left. We computed it with the R function qnorm: qnorm(0.95, 0, 1), which returns 1.64.

In a typical significance test the rejection region consists of one or both tails of the null distribution. The value of the test statistic that marks the start of the rejection region is a critical value.

**critical value 临界值**的下标记右尾概率, 分位点 qs​ 的下标记左尾概率. 因而 z0.05​=q0.95​≈1.645.

临界值是拒绝域的边界. 右尾检验中, 它比观测统计量更靠左还是更靠右, 决定观测值是否进入拒绝域.

可以统一记成 xα​=q1−α​: 下标 α 是右侧概率, 分位数下标 1−α 是左侧概率. 左尾边界看起来符号不同, 也只是因为拒绝方向反过来.

R 的 `qnorm` 始终接收左尾累计概率. 做题时先画出拒绝端, 再决定该给 `qnorm` 输入 α、1−α 还是双尾下的相应值.

Page 11 (17b)

Example 10. Critical values and rejection regions. Suppose our test statistic x has null distribution N(100,152). Suppose also that our rejection region is right-sided and we have a significance level of 0.05. The critical value x0.05​ is the 0.95 quantile: qnorm(0.95, 100, 15) returned 124.7.

右尾 5% 要求临界点左侧有 95% 概率, 所以使用 `qnorm(0.95,100,15)`, 得到 x0.05​=124.7.

拒绝域是其右侧. 这里下标 0.05 指右尾面积, `qnorm` 的参数 0.95 指左尾累计概率, 两者不要混淆.

Page 12 (17b)

Example 11. Critical values and rejection regions. Repeat the previous example for a left-sided rejection region with significance level of 0.05. In this case the critical value has 0.05 probability to its left and therefore 0.95 probability to its right. So we label it x0.95​. Since it is the 0.05 quantile compute it with qnorm(0.05, 100, 15), which returned 75.3.

左尾 5% 的临界值右侧留下 95% 概率, 所以记作 x0.95​, 同时它又是第 0.05 分位点 q0.05​.

代入同一 N(100,152) 得 75.3, 拒绝域在其左侧. 下标始终按右尾概率读, 图则更直观地显示拒绝面积在哪一端.

Page 12 (17b)

Example 12. Critical values. Repeat the previous example for a two-sided rejection region. Put half the significance in each tail.

Solution: To have a total significance of 0.05 we put 0.025 in each tail. That is, the left tail starts at x0.975​=q0.025​ and the right tail starts at x0.025​=q0.975​. We compute these values with qnorm(0.025, 100, 15) and qnorm(0.975, 100, 15). The values are shown in the figure below.

双尾检验把 α 平分到两端, 所以每尾用 α/2=0.025, 不是仍用 0.05.

左临界值 x0.975​=q0.025​=70.6, 右临界值 x0.025​=q0.975​=129.4. 拒绝域是 70.6 左侧和 129.4 右侧, 中间是不拒绝域.

两个 `qnorm` 参数之和为 1, 因为左尾 0.025 对应累计 0.025, 右尾 0.025 对应累计 0.975. 标准正态下双尾 5% 就对应熟悉的 q0.025​≈−1.96 与 q0.975​≈1.96.

本例只是再用 100+15z 换回原始尺度, 所以两个端点关于 100 对称.

p 值与 p 检验
p-values and the P-test

7 p 值
7 p-values

Page 12 (17b)

In practice people often specify the significance level and do the significance test using what are called p-values. We will first define p-value and then state the p-test. After that, we will illustrate it with figures and examples.

Definition. The p-value is the probability, assuming the null hypothesis, of seeing data at least as extreme as the experimental data. What ‘at least as extreme’ means depends on the experimental design.

P-test. If the p-value is less than the significance level α then we reject H0​. Otherwise we do not reject H0​.

**p-value p 值**是在 H0​ 下得到「至少同样极端」结果的概率. 什么叫更极端由备择假设和实验设计决定.

**P-test p 检验**的规则是 p<α 就拒绝, 否则不拒绝. p 值不是 P(H0​∣数据), 也不是结果由偶然产生的概率.

p 值把观测位置转换成零分布下的尾概率. 它越小, 说明在预先选定的极端方向上, 这份结果越难由 H0​ 解释.

但 p 值大并不证明 H0​, 只表示结果不够极端. 它也不直接衡量效应大小或实际重要性, 样本量很大时, 很小的效应也可能得到很小的 p 值.

Page 13 (17b)

Suppose we have a right-sided alternate hypothesis, so our rejection region is in the right tail of the range of possible outcomes. Suppose we get data x1​ which is in the rejection region.

Since the rejection region is right-sided, the phrase ‘at least as extreme’ means all values to the right of x1​. So, the p-value is the area of the striped region. Since x1​ is in the rejection region, the striped area p is less than the shaded area α. That is, p<α. In other words, we reject the null hypothesis when p<α.

右尾备择下, 从观测值 x1​ 向右的所有结果都至少同样极端, 所以 p 值是观测值右侧的条纹面积.

若 x1​ 已在临界值右侧, 它的右尾面积必然小于整个拒绝域面积 α. 因而「落入拒绝域」和「p<α」是同一件事的两种表达.

Page 13 (17b)

For completeness we show a figure where x1​ is not in the rejection region, so p>α. That is, we do not reject H0​ when p>α.

若 x1​ 位于临界值左侧, 从它开始向右的面积还包含整个拒绝域, 因此 p>α, 不拒绝.

两张图要把阴影与条纹分清: α 是预先给定的拒绝域概率, p 则由实际观测位置决定.

当观测值向右移动时, 右侧尾面积变小, p 值也变小; 当它移到临界值左侧时, 尾面积反而增大. 因此 p 值与观测位置的关系必须按拒绝方向理解.

原文笔误:连接 p 检验与拒绝域一段的 signifcance 应为 significance.

z 检验: 双尾、单尾与 IQ 例
z-tests: Two-sided, One-sided and the IQ Example

双尾 z 检验
z-tests, p-values (two-sided)

Slide 16

Suppose we have independent normal Data: x1​,…,xn​; with unknown mean μ, known σ.

  • Hypotheses: H0​:xi​∼N(μ0​,σ2), HA​: Two-sided: μ=μ0​.
  • z-value: standardized xˉ: z=σ/n​xˉ−μ0​​.
  • Test statistic: z.
  • Null distribution: Assuming H0​: z∼N(0,1).
  • Significance: Choose significanc level α (often α=0.05).
  • Two-sided rejection region: Left and right tails, with probability α/2 each.
  • Two sided p value: p=P(∣Z∣>∣z∣∣H0​).
  • Test: For p≤α we reject H0​ in favor of HA​, i.e. if p≤α, then z is in the rejection region.

已知总体标准差时, 样本均值标准化后在 H0​ 下服从标准正态. 双尾备择 μ=μ0​ 把拒绝域放在两端, 每尾概率为 α/2.

双尾 p 值看 ∣Z∣>∣z∣, 即不论方向, 得到绝对值更大的统计量的概率. 不能只取观测方向的一侧.

标准化的来源是 Xˉ∼N(μ0​,σ2/n). 减去 μ0​ 再除以 σ/n​, 就把任何已知 σ 的正态均值问题转换到同一个 N(0,1) 尺度.

双尾拒绝域因此可以统一写成 ∣z∣>zα/2​. 比较观测 ∣z∣ 与临界值, 和比较双尾 p 与 α, 会得到相同决定.

右尾 z 检验
z-tests, p-values (right-sided)

Slide 17

Independent normal Data: x1​,…,xn​; with unknown mean μ, known σ.

  • Hypotheses: H0​:xi​∼N(μ0​,σ2), HA​: Right-sided: μ>μ0​.
  • z-value: z=σ/n​xˉ−μ0​​.
  • Test statistic: z.
  • Null distribution: Assuming H0​: z∼N(0,1).
  • Significance: We set a significanc level α (often α=0.05).
  • Right-sided rejection region: Right tail, with probability α.
  • Right-sided p value: p=P(Z>z∣H0​).
  • Test: For p≤α we reject H0​ in favor of HA​, i.e. if p≤α, then z is in the rejection region.

右尾备择 μ>μ0​ 只把较大的样本均值视为支持备择的证据, 所以整个 α 都放在右尾, p=P(Z>z∣H0​).

易错:备择写成 μ=μ0​ 才用双尾; 不能仅因观测均值偏向一侧, 就在算完数据后把双尾改成单尾.

在右尾检验中, 若观测 z 很小甚至为负, 从它向右累计的概率会很大, 所以不会在这个右尾备择下拒绝 H0​. 这种结果可能支持相反方向, 但不是当前备择要找的证据.

7.1 z 检验例
7.1 Example: z-tests

Pages 13–14 (17b)

When our test statistic is standard normal we will call it z, and the corresponding test for significance will be called a z-test.

Example 13. The z-test for normal hypotheses

IQ is normally distributed in the population according to a N(100,152) distribution. We suspect that most MIT students have above average IQ so we frame the following hypotheses.

H0​=MIT student IQs are distributed identically to the general population=MIT IQ’s follow a N(100,152) distribution.
HA​=MIT student IQs tend to be higher than those of the general population=the average MIT student IQ is greater than 100.

Notice that HA​ is one-sided. Suppose we test 9 students and find they have an average IQ of xˉ=112. Can we reject H0​ at a significance level α=0.05?

Solution: To compute p we first standardize the data: Under the null hypothesis Xˉ∼N(100,152/9) and therefore

z=15/9​xˉ−100​=1536​=2.4∼N(0,1).

IQ 例的备择是平均值高于 100, 所以是右尾检验. 9 个学生的均值在 H0​ 下服从 N(100,152/9), 标准误为 15/9​=5.

观测均值 112 标准化后得到 z=(112−100)/5=2.4. 这个值表示样本均值比零假设中心高 2.4 个均值标准误, 不是个体 IQ 高 2.4 个标准差.

除以 9​ 反映的是均值比单个观测更稳定. 若误用 15 直接除, 就把个体分布与均值分布混为一谈, 会低估结果的极端程度.

检验结论还依赖抽样和模型假设, 包括学生样本能否代表所讨论的群体、正态模型和已知 σ 是否合理.

Pages 14–15 (17b)

That is, the null distribution for z is standard normal. We call z a z-statistic, we will use it as our test statistic. For a right-sided alternative hypothesis the phrase ‘data at least as extreme’ is a one-sided tail to the right of z. The p-value is then

p=P(Z≥2.4)=1- pnorm(2.4,0,1)=0.0081975.

Since p≤α we reject the null hypothesis. We phrase our conclusion as

We reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis that MIT students have higher IQs on average. We have done this at significance level 0.05 with a p-value of 0.008.

Notes: 1. The average xˉ=112 is random: if we ran the experiment again we could get a different value for xˉ. 2. We could use the statistic xˉ directly. Standardizing is fairly standard because, with practice, we will have a good feel for the meaning of different z-values.

In this example α=0.05, z0.05​=1.64 and the rejection region is the range to the right of z0.05​. Also, z=2.4 and the p-value is the probability to the right of z. The picture illustrates that

  • z=2.64 is in the rejection region
  • is the same as z is to the right of z0.05​
  • is the same as the probability to the right of z is less than 0.05
  • which means p<0.05.

右尾 p=P(Z≥2.4)=0.0081975<0.05, 所以拒绝. 用临界值判断也得到同一结论: 2.4>1.645, 观测值在拒绝域内.

结论严格说是「在该模型和显著性水平下拒绝 H0​」, 不是证明所有 MIT 学生智商都更高, 也不是 HA​ 有 99.2% 概率为真.

样本均值本身会随重复抽样变化. 标准化只是换到统一的 z 尺度, 方便使用同一个标准正态分布和临界值.

幻灯片错误:图下项目符号写 z=2.64 在拒绝域内, 与全文计算 z=2.4 及图中标记不一致, 应为 z=2.4. 2.64 只是偶然也落在拒绝域内, 不是本例统计量.

z 统计量课堂题
Board question: z statistic

Slides 19–21

Suppose we know the following about our null hypothesis significance test.

  • H0​: data follows a N(5,102)
  • HA​: data follows a N(μ,102) where μ=5.
  • Test statistic: z= standardized xˉ.
  • Data: 64 data points with xˉ=6.25.
  • Significance level set to α=0.05.

(a) Find the rejection region; draw a picture. (b) Find the z-value; add it to your picture. (c) Decide whether or not to reject H0​ in favor of HA​. (d) Find the p-value for this data; add to your picture. (e) What’s the connection between the answers to (b), (c) and (d)?

The null distribution ϕ(z∣H0​)∼N(0,1).

(a) The rejection region is ∣z∣>1.96, i.e. 1.96 or more standard deviations from the mean.

(b) Standardizing z=5/4xˉ−5​=1.251.25​=1.

(c) Do not reject since z is not in the rejection region.

(d) Use a two-sided p-value p=P(∣Z∣>1)=0.32.

(e) The z-value not being in the rejection region tells us exactly the same thing as the p-value being greater than the significance, i.e. don’t reject the null hypothesis H0​.

这里 σ/n​=10/8=1.25, 所以 z=(6.25−5)/1.25=1. 双尾 5% 拒绝域是 ∣z∣>1.96, z=1 落在中央.

双尾 p=P(∣Z∣>1)≈0.3173≈0.32>0.05. 临界值判据与 p 值判据都不拒绝, 但并不证明真实均值就是 5.

双尾概率要把右侧 Z>1 与左侧 Z<−1 的面积相加. 由标准正态对称性, 它就是单右尾面积的两倍.

图中 z=1 离零假设中心不算远, 而且位于 −1.96 与 1.96 之间, 所以「没那么异常」与 p 值较大表达的是同一判断.

卡方拟合优度与 t 检验预告
Chi-square Goodness of Fit and Student’s t Test

8 更多例子
8 More examples

Page 15 (17b)

Hypothesis testing is widely used in inferential statistics. We don’t expect that the following examples will make perfect sense at this time. Read them quickly just to get a sense of how hypothesis testing is used. We will explore the details of these examples in class.

Example 14. The chi-square statistic and goodness of fit. (Rice, example B, p.313)

To test the level of bacterial contamination, milk was spread over a grid with 400 squares. The amount of bacteria in each square was measured. We summarize in the table below. The bottom row of the table is the number of different squares that had a given amount of bacteria.

Amount of bacteria01234567891019
Number of squares5610480624227995321

We compute that the average amount of bacteria per square is 2.44. Since the Poisson(λ) distribution is used to model counts of relatively rare events and the parameter λ is the expected value of the distribution. we decide to see if these counts could come from a Poisson distribution. To do this we first graphically compare the observed frequencies with those expected from Poisson(2.44).

400 个方格中的细菌计数被整理成频数表, 平均每格为 2.44. 讲义先用 Poisson(2.44) 作为候选模型, 再把观察频数与该模型的期望频数画在一起比较.

图形只能提示是否失配, 不能单凭「看起来不像」作正式结论. 下一步用卡方统计量把各格差异汇总成一个检验.

频数表与概率表要区分: 表中 56、104 等是方格数量, 总和为 400; Poisson 给出的是每个计数类别的概率. 乘以 400 后才得到可与之直接比较的期望频数.

这里的 HA​ 是「来自不同分布」, 因而属于复合备择. 卡方统计量则专门汇总各类别与零模型的偏离.

Pages 15–16 (17b)

The picture is suggestive, so we do a hypothesis test with H0​: the samples come from a Poisson(2.44) distribution, HA​: the samples come from a different distribution.

We use a chi-square statistic, so called because it (approximately) follows a chi-square distribution. To compute X2 we first combine the last few cells in the table so that the minimum expected count is around 5 (a general rule-of-thumb in this game.)

The expected number of squares with a certain amount of bacteria comes from considering 400 trials from a Poisson(2.44) distribution, e.g., with λ=2.44 the expected number of squares with 3 bacteria is 400×e−λλ3/3!=84.4.

The chi-square statistic is ∑i​Ei​(Oi​−Ei​)2​, where Oi​ is the observed number and Ei​ is the expected number.

Number per square0123456>6
Observed5610480624227920
Expected34.985.1103.884.451.525.110.25.0
Component of X212.84.25.56.01.70.140.1544.5

**chi-square goodness-of-fit test 卡方拟合优度检验**比较每格观察数 Oi​ 与零模型期望数 Ei​. 期望数等于 400 乘相应的 Poisson 概率.

每格贡献 (Oi​−Ei​)2/Ei​, 观察与期望差得越多, 贡献越大. 尾部若干格合并, 使最小期望数约为 5, 以改善卡方近似.

除以 Ei​ 让差异按零模型下的规模来评估: 同样的绝对差, 在期望数很小的格子里会更异常. 平方则让正负偏差都累积, 不会相互抵消.

例如 >6 格观察到 20, 期望只有 5.0, 这一格的差异特别大, 所以它对总统计量的贡献远高于其他格.

Page 16 (17b)

Summing up we get X2=74.9. Since the mean (2.44) and the total number of trials (400) are fixed, the 8 cells only have 6 degrees of freedom. So, assuming H0​, our chi-square statistic follows (approximately) a χ62​ distribution. Using this distribution, P(X2>74.59)=0 (to at least 6 decimal places). Thus we decisively reject the null hpothesis in favor of the alternate hypothesis that the distribution is not Poisson(2.44).

To analyze further, look at the individual components of X2. There are large contributions in the tail of the distribution, so that is where the fit goes awry.

总卡方约为 74.9. 尾部合并成 8 格后, 总频数固定消耗 1 个自由度, 由数据估计 λ 再消耗 1 个, 所以 df=8−1−1=6.

这个统计量远大于 χ62​ 的常见波动, 因而拒绝泊松模型. >6 一格贡献 44.5, 是失配最主要的位置, 说明问题尤其在尾部而不是所有格均匀偏差.

自由度里的两次扣除对应两个约束: 各格总数必须等于 400, 泊松均值又由同一份数据估计. 剩下的独立比较维度因此是 6.

拒绝的是当前泊松模型及其拟合方式, 不是证明所有泊松分布都不可能描述类似数据. 逐项贡献帮助定位模型在哪些计数区间不合适.

原文笔误:null hpothesis 应为 null hypothesis. 同段先写总和 X2=74.9, 随后尾概率写 P(X2>74.59), 数值不一致; 两者在本例都得到极小尾概率, 不影响拒绝结论.

Page 16 (17b)

Example 15. Student’s t test.

Suppose we want to compare a medical treatment for increasing life expectancy with a placebo. We give n people the treatment and m people the placebo. Let X1​,…,Xn​ be the number of years people live after receiving the treatment. Likewise, let Y1​,…,Ym​ be the number of years people live after receiving the placebo. Let Xˉ and Yˉ be the sample means.

We want to know if the difference between Xˉ and Yˉ is statistically significant. We frame this as a hypothesis test. Let μX​ and μY​ be the (unknown) means.

H0​:μX​=μY​,HA​:μX​=μY​.

With certain assumptions and a proper formula for the pooled standard error sp​ the test statistic t=sp​Xˉ−Yˉ​ follow a t distribution with n+m−2 degrees of freedom. So our rejection region is determined by a threshold t0​ with P(t>t0​)=α.

**Student’s t test Student t 检验**比较两组均值. 这里 H0​:μX​=μY​, 双尾备择为两组均值不同.

在相应正态、独立与方差假设下, 统计量服从 n+m−2 自由度的 t 分布. 原文最后用右尾阈值只是示意临界值写法, 实际双尾应使用 ∣t∣ 的阈值. 具体标准误公式留待后续课程.

这里比较的是「两组均值之差」相对于其标准误有多大, 不是分别检验每个均值是否为零. 自由度中的 −2 对应两组各自估计一个均值, 后续会再结合合并方差公式理解.

原文笔误:the test statistic … follow a t distribution 主语为单数, 应为 follows.

两枚硬币: 换原假设后的检验
Two Coins: Switching the Null Hypothesis

更多硬币课堂题
Board question: More coins

Slide 22

Two coins: probability of heads is 0.5 for C1​; and 0.6 for C2​. We pick one at random, fli it 8 times and get 6 heads.

Here are the probability tables for the two coins

k012345678
p(k∣θ=0.5)0.0040.0310.1090.2190.2730.2190.1090.0310.004
p(k∣θ=0.6)0.0010.0080.0410.1240.2320.2790.2090.0900.017

(a) H0​= ‘The coin is C1​’, HA​= ‘The coin is C2​’. Do you reject H0​ at the significanc level α=0.05? (Hint: First decide if this test is two-sided, left-sided or right-sided. Then determine the rejection region.)

(b) H0​= ‘The coin is C2​’, HA​= ‘The coin is C1​’. Do you reject H0​ at the significanc level α=0.05?

(c) Do your answers to (a) and (b) seem paradoxical?

(a) 中备择 C2​ 更倾向正面, 用右尾. 在 C1​ 下 P(X≥6)=0.109375+0.03125+0.00390625≈0.1445>0.05, 不拒绝.

(b) 中备择 C1​ 相对更倾向反面, 用左尾. 在 C2​ 下 P(X≤6)≈0.893>0.05, 同样不拒绝.

为什么不矛盾:两次检验的零分布和极端方向都不同. 数据更支持 C2​ 一些, 但在 8 次投掷的小样本下, 无论把哪枚硬币设为默认, 都不足以在 0.05 水平拒绝它.

单看 6 次正面, C2​ 的似然约为 0.209, C1​ 约为 0.109, 所以数据相对更偏向 C2​. 但 NHST 的 p 值还要累计至少同样极端的所有结果, 不是只比较这一个点的似然.

两次不拒绝也不表示两枚硬币被证明相同. 它们本来就具有不同的已知正面概率, 只是当前样本不足以按这两个检验规则排除任何一个.

如果把两枚硬币随机取一枚的过程放进贝叶斯框架, 还可以结合取币先验计算后验. 但本题是纯频率派检验, 每次只保留一个零假设及其尾概率, 不使用「两枚硬币等可能被取到」来计算后验.

原文笔误:fli it 8 times 应为 flip it 8 times; 两处 significanc level 应为 significance level.
